name: Band Seated Twist
steps: Sit sideways to a chest-height band anchor with your legs extended and both hands holding the band in front of you.
Sit tall with your hips grounded and take up the slack.
Turn your chest away from the anchor, moving your hands and ribs together.
Alternate smooth turns away from and toward the anchor, then face the other way to reverse the pull.
tips: Keep both sitting bones anchored evenly on the floor as your shoulders rotate.
Turn your rib cage with your hands rather than swinging only your arms from side to side.
